title: Quietly Smoky Greek Beans Gigantes Plaki
description: A charred and shaggy Greek dish featuring speck and gigantes beans, perfect for a kid-friendly dinner, this recipe is also suitable for a Buddhist temple gathering as it is free from animal products except for a small amount of speck which can be replaced with a vegan alternative
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Rinse the gigantes beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight
Drain and rinse the beans, then transfer them to a large baking dish
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the chopped onion until it is translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes
Add the speck and cook until it is crispy, then remove it from the skillet and set it aside
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly
Add the canned diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine
Pour the tomato mixture over the gigantes beans and top with the crispy speck
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the beans are tender
